item.title: Critical zero-day exploited in popular VPN appliances
item.description: Researchers have reported active exploitation of two vulnerabilities affecting a widely used class of VPN appliances. By chaining the flaws, an attacker may gain remote access to an exposed device before authentication. The vendor has published security updates and recommends reviewing access logs, limiting internet exposure and applying the patches promptly. The scope of confirmed incidents remains under investigation; organizations should follow official advisories for affected versions and mitigation steps.

item.title: Chip, nuovi ordini miliardari per le schede di intelligenza artificiale
item.description: Le grandi aziende tecnologiche continuano a investire in acceleratori per l'intelligenza artificiale e nella costruzione di nuovi data center. Gli ordini riflettono la domanda di capacità di calcolo, ma anche la necessità di energia, reti e sistemi di raffreddamento adeguati. Gli analisti avvertono che tempi di consegna e costi potrebbero influenzare i piani di espansione. Le società non hanno ancora dettagliato l'impatto degli acquisti sui singoli progetti.

item.title: Phishing campaign impersonates tax agencies across Europe
item.description: Security researchers have identified a phishing campaign that imitates tax agencies in several European countries. Messages direct recipients to convincing but fraudulent pages designed to collect login details and personal information. The campaign appears to have reached thousands of users in a week, although the number of victims is not yet known. Authorities advise checking the sender and accessing official services through their known websites rather than links in unexpected messages.
